title: SIMAI Framework language pack v1
description: Every word of one language for one delivery (the Framework, ui-pro, ui-chart, a product), by component. ru and en are built into the components; any other language is a pack, fetched only by a page in that language. Spec: docs/developer/language-packs.md (owner decision C177, 2026-11-14).

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema.

schema.description: The format, named without a version.

delivery.description: Whose words: framework, pro, chart, or a product's own name. A Framework pack's words give way to any other pack's and to words registered one by one.

lang.description: The language, a lower-case BCP 47 tag: kk, de, pt-br. A region tag is tried before its language.

name.description: The language's name in itself: Қазақша, Deutsch.

dir.description: The writing direction of the language.

status.description: draft: not yet read by a native speaker (a machine draft, an unchecked translation); reviewed: read and corrected by one.

review.description: Who reviewed it, or what is still to check.

coverage.description: How much of the delivery's words the pack says; the rest is said in English. Written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs.

words.description: The words by component, under the name the component registers its words with: its tag (sf-pagination), or the name its documentation gives (sf-file-size for size units).

additionalProperties.description: One component's words: the keys of its lang/en.json runtime.

oneOf.description: A word or phrase. {name} is filled by the component; {n} is a number in the language's own digits.
A word that takes a number: one string per plural category of the language (Intl.PluralRules), other always.
